title: Rice Stock Arrival Alert Screen for Ration Shop
title_te: రేషన్ షాపు బియ్యం స్టాక్ సమాచార స్క్రీన్
problem: Grandmothers walk 2 kilometers in hot sun to the ration shop, only to find the shop closed because rice stocks have not arrived yet.
idea: A simple display board. The ration dealer taps one button to show if rice is available, coming tomorrow, or the shop is closed. A photo of the board can be sent to the village WhatsApp group.

widgets.heading: 🎯 Try it: Dealer updates the board
widgets.intro: This works like my Scratch display. Tap the button the dealer presses.
widgets.question: Today the ration shop status is…

options.label: Rice available
options.result: RICE AVAILABLE TODAY. Come with your ration card.
options.te: ఈరోజు బియ్యం అందుబాటులో ఉంది. రేషన్ కార్డుతో రండి.

options.label: Coming tomorrow
options.result: Stock arriving TOMORROW. Please don't walk today.

options.label: Long queue
options.result: Rice available, but long queue now. Come after 4 pm.
options.te: బియ్యం ఉంది, కానీ ఇప్పుడు పెద్ద క్యూ. సాయంత్రం 4 తర్వాత రండి.

widgets.heading: 🚶‍♀️ How Many Wasted Walks Does It Save?

inputs.label: Distance to ration shop, one way (km)
Wasted trips in a month (shop closed / no stock)

widgets.formula: if ([km, wasted, people].some(function(x){return typeof x !== 'number' || x < 0;})) return null; var total = km * 2 * wasted * people; var hours = total / 3; return {total: total, hours: Math.round(hours * 10) / 10, level: total > 0 ? 'good' : 'warn'};
widgets.result:
The board can save {total} km of walking every month.
That is about {hours} hours in the hot sun (walking about 3 km per hour).

how: Talk to the ration dealer and ask if he would update a simple board every morning.
In Scratch, make one sprite with 4 costumes: green 'Available', yellow 'Tomorrow', red 'Closed', orange 'Long queue'.
Make 4 buttons. When a button is clicked, switch to that costume and say the message.
Add a Telugu voice using the Text to Speech extension.
In Canva, make a printed version with the same colours for people without phones.
The dealer can take a screenshot of the board and send it to the village WhatsApp group.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student making a ration shop status board in Scratch. Write 4 short, polite messages in simple Telugu and English for: rice available today, stock coming tomorrow, shop closed today, and long queue now.
